item.title: SUNshine Girl Jade
item.description: SUNshine Girl Jade has her eyes set on a career in the entertainment industry, working as an actor, screenwriter and producer. The 5-foot-5 brown-eyed Sagittarius likes writing dark comedies. Her other hobbies include playing video games. Her dream car is a convertible. She posed for us in June 2018. (Dave Abel/Toronto Sun)
